summary_en: This study tests β-hydroxybutyrate (BHB) supplementation in adults with large B-cell lymphoma who are receiving anti-CD19 CAR T-cell therapy. Participants take 35 mL of HVMN Ketone-IQ by mouth three times daily, with each dose containing 10 grams of R-1,3-Butanediol; the duration is not stated. The study aims to measure feasibility, safety and tolerability, and whether BHB supplementation changes the gut microbiome and peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs). Phase: not applicable (NA).
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa la suplementación con β-hidroxibutirato (BHB) en adultos con linfoma de células B grandes que reciben terapia con células T CAR anti-CD19. Los participantes toman por vía oral 35 mL de HVMN Ketone-IQ tres veces al día, y cada dosis contiene 10 gramos de R-1,3-Butanediol; la duración no se indica. El estudio busca medir la factibilidad, la seguridad y la tolerabilidad, y si la suplementación con BHB cambia el microbioma intestinal y las células mononucleares de sangre periférica (PBMC). Fase: no aplica (NA).
who_for: Age 18 years or older with pathologically confirmed large B-cell lymphoma
Planned treatment with an anti-CD19 CAR-T product (Yescarta or Kymriah)
Performance status ECOG 2 or less and adequate organ function per investigator
At least one measurable lesion documented before leukapheresis
Toxicities from prior therapy resolved to a grade that does not contraindicate participation
not_for: History of allergy to energy drinks
History of type 1 diabetes or need for insulin
History of chronic kidney disease with eGFR below 30 mL/min/1.73m2
